'''Servant Four''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. She was a [[Servant]] of the [[Hand of the Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> Servant Four, as well as a number of other Servants from the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] boarded the [[Kira Carsen's ship|ship]] used by [[Kira Carsen]] and [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] to protect [[Satele Shan]] and her students after they were exposed to [[Tenebrae's curse]], with the intention of helping their master [[Tenebrae]] rise again. They were stalled by [[Scions of Zakuul]], lead by [[Minazar]], but the Servants slaughtered them, their numbers being far greater.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

Eager to move the ship to another location, Servant Four then called [[Servant Fifteen]] and [[Servant Twenty-two]] on the engineering deck to demand a status update and was told that every time they fix one system that another suddenly failed; the sabotage was perpetrated by [[T7-O1]]. Servant Four then cut off the transmission as soon as her fellow Servants were recklessly confronted by Scourge, accompanied by Carsen and the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

Servant Four gathered the remaining Servants in the medical bay, where they gathered up the comatose Jedi, at the same time the Commander's party arrived. As a critically wounded Minazar stumbled out, cryptically claiming that late [[Heskal]]'s prophecy had come to fruition, Servant Four stepped out to face her foes and proclaimed they would not stop them from resurrecting the Sith Emperor. In response to Minazar's defiant protest that Valkorion's "last vestige" would be saved from the corruption of the Sith, Servant Four mocked the Scions as ignorant puppets, claiming the Servants were the Emperor's true followers, before executing him. She and the remaining Servants then attacked the Commander's party, only to be all killed in the ensuing fight.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Servant Four appears in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]] expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Onslaught]]'', in '''Game Update: 6.3: Echoes of Vengeance'''.

The player has three dialogues choices with Servant Four:
*If player says the Sith were a means to an end, Servant Four fiercely rejects those words as lies.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />
*If the player agreed with the Sith, saying the Zakuulans never knew the true nature of their Immortal Emperor, Minazar would indignantly label the player as ignorant, claiming the Scions' visions pierced all truths. Servant Four retorted that Valkorion showed the Scions only what he allowed while exploiting their minds and body as fuel for his immortality.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />
*If the player says both the Sith and Scions were deceived by an uncaring master, Servant Four proclaimed it his right as a god.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

If [[Arcann]] and [[Senya Tirall]] survived the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion, they would both make an emotional plea, asserting that Valkorion manipulated the Servants as surely as he did his own family.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

Regardless, Servant Four would execute Minazar regardless.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />
